headDemo: Three drops, three sell-outs. The Nightcut 2 went in 11 minutes, and every crew member got in 24 hours early.
accordion: When does the next drop land?
We post the date 48 hours out. Crew members get in first.
How do I join a crew?
Find one in your city on the crew map, show up to two runs, and you are in.
Can I race without a crew?
Yes. Solo runners join a pace group on the night.
What if my size sells out?
Every drop restocks once, and crew members get the alert first.

rules.text: Black (#0B0B0B) and bright red (#FF2A2A), nothing else as a ground. Dark red (#8E0000) is for rules, chart bars behind the lead, the error outline and the table highlight column; grey (#9A9A9A) is muted text on black only; chalk (#EDEDED) is reading text on black only. No white or off-white surface, cards or panels, ever.

On red, every word is black (5.26:1), including small text; chalk or white text never sits on bright red. On black, reading text is chalk, muted text grey, and red may be text at any size (5.26:1). On dark red only chalk is written, and only in the table highlight column (8.34:1).

Red is a fill, not a hairline: the red cover, quote and closing grounds, event cards, the table header, chips, buttons, the 12px stat bar, the 8px card bar, the 120×12 title bar, giant numerals and the cut. Thin lines are dark red.
Zero radius everywhere: cards, buttons, chips, tabs, bars, tables and images are square. The only angle is 45°: the cut, the corner cut and the slanted image mask.

The cut sits top-right on the cover, section and closing slides, the corner cut in the top-right 200px of content slides, the halftone bottom-right on the quote slide; nothing touches the bottom-left logo or its clear space (half the logo height), or the cover pager.

A state is never colour alone: error is dark red with a ✕ and a word, drawn as an outlined box (a 3px black line on red, or a dark-red line on black), never as a red fill that reads like a button; success (chalk ✓), warning (pale red ⚠) and info (grey ⓘ) carry their glyphs. KPI deltas are muted grey.
Display, headings, numerals and quotes are Anton, uppercase and huge; reading text is Archivo in sentence case; labels, chips, tabs and buttons are Archivo 800 uppercase with wide tracking.
Short sentences, hard numbers. At most one exclamation mark per slide, never in a title, a chart or a table.
No photographs of people, no silhouettes and no stock images; imagery is speed, light, tracks, tread and paint. Quotes name a role, never a person.
No gradients. Text over an image sits on a flat black scrim; halftone dots do the fading.
